shows.title: Apple shows
shows.description: Apple Podcasts show IDs or show links, for example https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/houston-we-have-a-podcast/id1262594123. Each one is resolved to the show's public RSS feed.

feedUrls.title: RSS feed URLs
feedUrls.description: Public podcast RSS feed URLs. Each feed host's robots.txt is checked first, including redirects.

maxShows.title: Maximum shows
maxShows.description: Global cap on unique discovered feed URLs.

maxEpisodesPerShow.title: Episodes per show
maxEpisodesPerShow.description: Maximum matching unique episodes per feed, preserving feed order.

publishedAfter.title: Published after
publishedAfter.description: Exclusive lower timestamp bound. Date-only input means midnight UTC. Unknown dates are excluded when filtering.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Request interval
requestDelaySeconds.description: Minimum seconds between serial requests, including retries.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: Safety bound on source pages scanned. Filters can result in fewer saved items.
